meta.title: Blockchain Forensics & On-Chain Investigation | Lenix Protocol
meta.description: Trace stolen and misdirected crypto, map wallet flows, and produce forensic reports for counsel, compliance teams, and law enforcement. Honest scope before engagement.

Hero.subtitle: Lenix maps transaction flows across chains and prepares documented findings for recovery decisions, legal review, and compliance — without promising outcomes the ledger cannot support.

Capabilities.title: What forensic work covers
Capabilities.description: Investigations combine on-chain analysis with matter context — not automated blockchain lookups alone.

tracing.title: Transaction tracing
tracing.desc: Follow fund movement from known source wallets through bridges, mixers, and consolidation points to identify where value likely landed.

reports.title: Reports and litigation support
reports.desc: Written analysis with timelines, methodology, and limitations — formatted for counsel, regulators, or exchange escalation when appropriate.

compliance.title: Compliance and due diligence
compliance.desc: Screen wallets and flows for AML risk, sanctions exposure, and counterparty diligence before treasury moves or settlement.

UseCases.title: When teams engage forensics
UseCases.description: Common matters where documented on-chain analysis helps decide next steps — recovery, legal process, or internal review.

theft.title: Theft and unauthorized transfers
theft.desc: Wallet compromises, exchange account takeovers, or unauthorized outbound transfers where you need a trace before contacting platforms.

scams.title: Scams and social engineering
scams.desc: Investment fraud, impersonation, and phishing cases where victims need to show fund paths to counsel or reporting channels.

ransom.title: Extortion payments
ransom.desc: Ransomware or blackmail payments where law enforcement or insurers require documented flow analysis from payment wallets.

insolvency.title: Disputes and insolvency
insolvency.desc: Bankruptcy, creditor enforcement, or internal investigations where attachable crypto or treasury movements must be verified.

panel.title: Confidential handling
panel.description: Case materials are shared only with parties authorized under the engagement — not used outside the defined scope.

intake.title: Intake and scoping
intake.desc: Known addresses, transaction hashes, timelines, and what questions the matter needs answered — before analysis hours are committed.

extract.title: Data extraction
extract.desc: Pull relevant on-chain data across supported networks, including internal transfers, contract interactions, and exchange touchpoints where visible.

analyze.title: Analysis and clustering
analyze.desc: Map flows, cluster related addresses, and separate verified movements from inference — with limits stated explicitly.

deliver.title: Report and next steps
deliver.desc: Deliver findings with recommended paths: exchange escalation, legal process, recovery coordination, or closure when trails are exhausted.

Cta.title: Need a forensic read on a case?
Cta.description: Share what happened and the on-chain details you already have. We respond with an honest assessment of what tracing can show before scoped engagement.
